metadata.description: High-effort learner who invests far more hours per concept than anyone else and still masters few of them. Quantitative work is hard, descriptive biology genuinely is not.
metadata.disclaimer: Synthetic research persona generated by stepzero.student_profiles. This is designed test material, not observed data, and it is not derived from or calibrated against any real student. It exists to give Project Step Zero v1.0 controlled, reproducible inputs for recommendation, simulation, and evaluation experiments, and is expected to be replaced or calibrated once primary research data is collected.
design_notes: Biology categories carry large positive modifiers so the profile is not uniformly weak, which is the point, a struggling learner is not weak at everything.
Attempt counts and hours per concept are the highest of any persona.
Confidence is biased downward, this learner underrates real ability.

chemical_bonding and dna_structure are pinned as required so the descriptive biology track this learner is actually good at cannot be lost to a coverage draw, and because that track depends on chemistry across subjects.
redox is deliberately out of reach, so cellular_respiration stays blocked behind it.
mendelian_genetics is a deliberate bright spot, linear_equations a deliberate gap.
